R11, R10 (T50; N1092): with no module registered only: watched and only: flagged answer empty with undetermined, never unfiltered; a read that throws, answers a promise or another shape is no marks — watched false everywhere, undetermined said; a hidden flagged item is not listed
R1, R15: a capture the viewer may not see, in an enumerated set or a selection, is left out and counted nowhere — every answer is byte-identical to one where it is absent; the participant sees it
R1, R16: a find writes nothing — no selection, no observation row, no fact, no reading, no content row (row counts and rows unchanged) — and calls no model
R1, R2 (DEC-98): a kind with nothing says Nothing here only when every capture was read for it; beside it a kind with an unread capture lists it in not_read with why and never says Nothing here

R1: a scope of each form — a capture, a selection (read under its owner through the host's selectionRead), an enumerated set of bundle ids and capture shas, a project's holdings — answers its captures in capture-sha order
R1: at most 200 captures are read per call, in capture-sha order, next naming where to continue and null when the scope is done; a paged scope never says Nothing here

R1: the refusals, in order, each writing nothing: VIEWER_MISSING, NO_SCOPE, SCOPE_UNKNOWN, CAPTURE_NOT_HELD, NO_SUCH_SELECTION, NO_SUCH_PROJECT, SCOPE_TOO_LARGE, NO_KINDS, KIND_UNKNOWN, NO_TERM, TERM_TOO_LONG
R1: words are at most 500 characters, cut at a word with …, the whole extent kept; limit bounds each kind's items (1–500, default 50) with truncated by reading one past

R2 (K1468): a sheet's amount column and date column are each one result naming the table — its capture, extent, column and row count, its words the header — never one item per row; other cells are matched on their own words
R2 (K5148, WALK-FINAL-08 D5): a stop ends a sentence only before whitespace and a capital or at the end, never inside a number, a citation or after a known abbreviation; a line break always ends one

R2 events: the items, motions and votes the minutes and agenda readers read, as extraction holds the reading, each with the reader's item fields as given; a capture of another type is in not_read with 'not minutes or an agenda'

R2 money, dates, requirements over fixed English fixtures: each match with its words, extent and origin; the same matches twice; never a force; a deadline's period only where stated plainly, never a due date

R2 people (K1972; entities R52): the followed people and offices are looked for by one namingIn read per page of captures, never per entity and never capped by count; truncated is namingIn's page, and a truncated kind never says Nothing here

R2 people, R2 term (DEC-164 (7)): a followed person or office is found by its held name, with the entity and how it corresponded, nothing resolved; a name no registered entity holds is found only as a word, under term
R21 (R17a, fix round 10, G3; retrieval R95) a term hit names the part it lies in, `part`: a footnote's hit says footnote, a body paragraph's body, a unit stored without a kind null
R21, R17a (fix round 10, follow-up 22) a find over a held document whose term hit lies in a footnote part answers a term item carrying that part, as screens-daily draws it

R3 (DEC-99): the matchers' words are held per language in FIND_MATCHERS, frozen, English held; a capture whose language has no set is in not_read for money, dates and requirements with 'no matcher for <language> yet', never matched with English; with no language stated none is assumed

R1 (T50; N1191 (d)): a fact recorded from one paragraph marks only the matches in that paragraph — two matches in it both carry it (same); a fact recorded with the extent document, a whole table or the page around marks none

R5 (T50; N1123): every match names its document by title, and the answer's scope does: a capture's, a project's own, a selection's and an enumerated set's none; a hidden bundle's title is never answered to a viewer who may not see it

R6 (T50; N1177): a match with an extent carries content_id, the id of the content row held for that capture and extent (a table item: its table.extent), or null with content_held false; a find mints nothing; a row held in a bundle the viewer may not see is none to them

R7 (T50; N1183): a match's words keep a passage's line breaks — a run of whitespace holding a line break is one line break, any other run one space; the 500-character cut at a word is unchanged; a passage with no line break answers the words it did

R8 (T50; N1191 (b)): a match found in a sheet names its sheet, the row's sheet-range and the row's cells in column order; a formula cell with no cached value is listed with value null, its formula and cached null, and its address in not_calculated; a formula with a cached value answers that value and is not

R8 (T50): a CSV hit answers its row as separate cells; a row of more than 50 cells lists 50 with cells_truncated; a sheet the reading holds no typed cells for names the sheet and the unit's range with cells null and why

R8 (T51; N1238; K3775; SCREENS-DAILY #7 J2): every match found in a sheet also carries row, the number of the sheet row it lies in — a term hit the row of its range, a cell found as a sheet-cell the row of its address, a CSV hit alike; a column result (a table item) and a match of a unit's own text, where no row can be named, carry row null; a text file's match carries no row key

R9 (T50; N1193): people also finds a held alias of a registered person or office in the words of the scope's text units — once per (unit, entity), correspondence name_in_passage; the first name alone is not found, a withdrawn alias is not, a name two entities hold lists each, an alias that folds to nothing is skipped
R9 (T50): a reference already found for the same entity in the same unit is not listed twice, and a capture with no text unit is in not_read with why, never Nothing here

R12 (DEC-330 A14): each item carries its state, the bundle's current_state as stored, null for a person; the answer carries total, the whole set matching kinds, only and since, and awaiting_review, the documents in state collected among them — three collected documents, one verified, a question and a person, one more collected document hidden: total 6 and awaiting_review 3

R13 (DEC-330 A15): BROWSE_SCOPES is the closed list of scopes — everything, question, document, action, awaiting_review, watched and flagged, each {key, kinds, only}, none named in English — and scopeMembers answers, for each key, the ids R10 lists for the same kinds and only, entities counted apart
R13 (DEC-330 A15): only has a fourth value, awaiting_review — the items R12 counts, ONLY_UNKNOWN names the four — and its total is its count; it holds documents only, whatever kinds are asked

R13, R15, R16 (DEC-330 A15): a scope over a hidden bundle lists no such id for a viewer who may not see it, an unrecognised viewer holds nothing, a marks read that cannot be read says undetermined and lists nothing unfiltered, and reading a scope writes nothing

R1, R4 (N715): recorded_read names the reads that answered; recorded_not_read names each that refused, threw, answered a promise (its rejection caught) or answered another shape, with why, and the line saying no later module is registered; such a read changes nothing else

R1 (N715; T50 N1191 (d)): each match carries recorded — every item of the four reads whose extent is the same as or narrower than the match's, with its module, record, kind, field, relation, by, at and withdrawn; a wider one (a whole-document fact) and a disjoint one are not; recorded: [] when none
R1 (N715): a table result is related through its table.extent by content.extentRelation; a match with no extent is recorded by nothing; reading writes nothing

R1 (N715): each of the four reads is called once per capture the call reads, in events, standards, money, people order, under the same viewer with limit 500 and no extent; a hidden record is neither shown nor counted; a truncated read marks its capture's matches recorded_truncated

R1, R4 (N715): recorded_read names the reads that answered; recorded_not_read names each that refused, threw, answered a promise (its rejection caught) or answered another shape, with why, and the line saying no later module is registered; such a read changes nothing else

R2 (N724): a .docx table held as cells is a held table — its date column and its amount column are each one result naming the table (its capture, its doc-table extent, the column and the row count, its words the header), never one item per row or cell; other cells and the body are matched as paragraphs

R1: the refusals, in order, each writing nothing: VIEWER_MISSING, NO_SCOPE, SCOPE_UNKNOWN, CAPTURE_NOT_HELD, NO_SUCH_SELECTION, NO_SUCH_PROJECT, SCOPE_TOO_LARGE, NO_KINDS, KIND_UNKNOWN, NO_TERM, TERM_TOO_LONG

R1: a scope of each form — a capture, a selection (read under its owner through the host's selectionRead), an enumerated set of bundle ids and capture shas, a project's holdings — answers its captures in capture-sha order
R1, R15: a capture the viewer may not see, in an enumerated set or a selection, is left out and counted nowhere — every answer is byte-identical to one where it is absent; the participant sees it
R1, R2 (DEC-98): a kind with nothing says Nothing here only when every capture was read for it; beside it a kind with an unread capture lists it in not_read with why and never says Nothing here

R2 people, R2 term (DEC-164 (7)): a followed person or office is found by its held name, with the entity and how it corresponded, nothing resolved; a name no registered entity holds is found only as a word, under term

R2 people (K1972; entities R52): the followed people and offices are looked for by one namingIn read per page of captures, never per entity and never capped by count; truncated is namingIn's page, and a truncated kind never says Nothing here

R2 money, dates, requirements over fixed English fixtures: each match with its words, extent and origin; the same matches twice; never a force; a deadline's period only where stated plainly, never a due date
R2 (K5148, WALK-FINAL-08 D5): a stop ends a sentence only before whitespace and a capital or at the end, never inside a number, a citation or after a known abbreviation; a line break always ends one

R3 (DEC-99): the matchers' words are held per language in FIND_MATCHERS, frozen, English held; a capture whose language has no set is in not_read for money, dates and requirements with 'no matcher for <language> yet', never matched with English; with no language stated none is assumed

R2 (K1468): a sheet's amount column and date column are each one result naming the table — its capture, extent, column and row count, its words the header — never one item per row; other cells are matched on their own words

R2 events: the items, motions and votes the minutes and agenda readers read, as extraction holds the reading, each with the reader's item fields as given; a capture of another type is in not_read with 'not minutes or an agenda'
R1: words are at most 500 characters, cut at a word with …, the whole extent kept; limit bounds each kind's items (1–500, default 50) with truncated by reading one past
R1: at most 200 captures are read per call, in capture-sha order, next naming where to continue and null when the scope is done; a paged scope never says Nothing here
R1, R16: a find writes nothing — no selection, no observation row, no fact, no reading, no content row (row counts and rows unchanged) — and calls no model
R21 (R17a, fix round 10, G3; retrieval R95) a term hit names the part it lies in, `part`: a footnote's hit says footnote, a body paragraph's body, a unit stored without a kind null
R21, R17a (fix round 10, follow-up 22) a find over a held document whose term hit lies in a footnote part answers a term item carrying that part, as screens-daily draws it

R10 (T50; N1092): new_since needs since and lists only what changed strictly later; new is true only then; the refusals, in order — VIEWER_MISSING, KIND_UNKNOWN, ONLY_UNKNOWN, NO_SINCE, BAD_SINCE — each reading nothing

R10 (T50; N1092): a bundle the gate does not pass is neither listed nor counted — an absent or unrecognised viewer sees nothing, never everything — and browsing writes nothing and moves nothing, however often it is read

R11 (T50; N1092): registerBrowseMarks — a malformed registration, and a second whoever makes it, are refused through membership's listenerRefusal; with a registered stub only: watched lists the viewer's own watches and none of another member's, only: flagged every flag, and a flag shows by, at and note to every viewer who sees the item

R11, R10 (T50; N1092): with no module registered only: watched and only: flagged answer empty with undetermined, never unfiltered; a read that throws, answers a promise or another shape is no marks — watched false everywhere, undetermined said; a hidden flagged item is not listed
